description: This file contains Polymer framework initialization and component registration code, including class definitions, feature setup, and rendering status management.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Base class providing core features for Polymer elements, including lifecycle callbacks, property management, behaviors, and attribute serialization.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: Main namespace object for Polymer framework, including class factory, version, and utility functions.

classes.name: Polymer.RenderStatus
classes.description: Manages rendering lifecycle, including readiness callbacks and next render queue.

classes.name: Polymer.ImportStatus
classes.description: Alias for RenderStatus, indicating import load status.

classes.name: Polymer.telemetry
classes.description: Tracks registration and usage telemetry for Polymer components.

classes.name: DomModule
classes.description: Represents a <dom-module> element for defining custom element templates and registration.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Removes 'unresolved' attribute from document body to signal component readiness.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Determines Polymer configuration based on URL parameters and environment features.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom element with the browser using document.registerElement.

methods.name: desugar
methods.description: Prepares a prototype for registration, handling inheritance and callback setup.

methods.name: dumpRegistrations
methods.description: Logs all registered Polymer prototypes.

methods.name: whenReady
methods.description: Registers a callback to execute when Polymer is ready.

methods.name: _makeReady
methods.description: Marks Polymer as ready and executes queued callbacks.

methods.name: afterNextRender
methods.description: Schedules a callback to run after the next render cycle of a given element.

methods.name: _flushNextRender
methods.description: Executes all callbacks scheduled for the next render.

methods.name: createdCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback for element creation, initializes features.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback for when element is attached to DOM.

methods.name: detachedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback for when element is detached from DOM.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Handles attribute changes and triggers corresponding behavior.

methods.name: _addFeature
methods.description: Adds features or behaviors to the Polymer element prototype.

methods.name: _marshalHostAttributes
methods.description: Applies host attributes to the element.

methods.name: _applyAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes on a node based on a provided attribute map.

methods.name: _takeAttributesToModel
methods.description: Copies element attributes to the element's property model.

methods.name: _setAttributeToProperty
methods.description: Converts an attribute value to a property value based on type.

methods.name: serializeValueToAttribute
methods.description: Serializes a property value to an attribute string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts attribute string to a property value based on type.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a property value to a string suitable for attribute.

methods.name: _setupDebouncers
methods.description: Initializes debouncing infrastructure.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Schedules a debounced callback.

methods.name: isDebouncerActive
methods.description: Checks if a debouncer is active.

methods.name: flushDebouncer
methods.description: Immediately executes a debounced callback.

methods.name: cancelDebouncer
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled debounced callback.

methods.name: _prepIs
methods.description: Prepares element identifier.

methods.name: _desugarBehaviors
methods.description: Processes behaviors into the element prototype.

methods.name: _flattenBehaviorsList
methods.description: Flattens nested behavior arrays.

methods.name: _mixinBehavior
methods.description: Mixes behavior properties into the element.

methods.name: _prepBehaviors
methods.description: Prepares behaviors for the element.

methods.name: _prepFlattenedBehaviors
methods.description: Prepares a list of behaviors.

methods.name: _doBehavior
methods.description: Invokes a behavior method.

methods.name: _invokeBehavior
methods.description: Calls a specific behavior method.

methods.name: _marshalBehaviors
methods.description: Finalizes behavior setup.

methods.name: _getExtendedPrototype
methods.description: Retrieves extended native prototype for a tag.

methods.name: getNativePrototype
methods.description: Returns native DOM prototype for a tag.

methods.name: _prepConstructor
methods.description: Prepares constructor function for custom element.

methods.name: _factory
methods.description: Creates an element instance with arguments.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends a prototype with properties or behaviors.

methods.name: mixin
methods.description: Copies properties from source to target.

methods.name: _addHostAttributes
methods.description: Adds host attributes to the element.

methods.name: _marshalHostAttributes
methods.description: Applies host attributes to the element.

methods.name: _attributeChangedImpl
methods.description: Handles attribute change logic.

methods.name: _registerFeatures
methods.description: Registers core features for the element.

methods.name: _prepIs
methods.description: Prepares element's 'is' identifier.
